# InfoSecurity Global Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

InfoSecurity Global delivered exceptional financial performance for the fiscal year ending December 2024, demonstrating the company's strong position in the manufacturing technology sector. The company reported record revenue of $5.26 million, representing a robust 32.8% year-over-year growth from the previous year's $3.96 million. Net income reached $678,645, reflecting disciplined operational execution and effective cost management. With an operating margin of 12.9%, InfoSecurity Global continues to demonstrate its ability to scale efficiently while investing in strategic growth initiatives across its core product portfolio.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's impressive 32.8% revenue growth significantly outpaced industry averages, driven by increased demand for integrated manufacturing solutions and successful market penetration strategies. Revenue per employee reached approximately $1,394, indicating strong productivity levels across the organization's 3,770-person workforce. The healthy operating margin of 12.9% reflects InfoSecurity Global's focus on operational efficiency and strategic resource allocation. This profitability metric demonstrates the company's ability to maintain margin discipline while pursuing aggressive growth objectives, with net income representing approximately 12.9% of total revenue, showcasing effective expense management and scalable business operations.

## Business Segment Performance

InfoSecurity Global's three core product divisions all contributed meaningfully to the company's strong performance. The Supply Chain solutions segment benefited from heightened focus on supply chain resilience and visibility among manufacturing clients, particularly in the post-pandemic recovery environment. The Production Planning division saw increased adoption as manufacturers sought to optimize capacity utilization and reduce operational inefficiencies. The Maintenance solutions segment experienced steady growth as clients prioritized predictive maintenance capabilities to minimize downtime and extend asset lifecycles. The integrated nature of these offerings has strengthened customer relationships and increased average contract values, contributing to improved customer retention rates and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to fiscal 2025, InfoSecurity Global is well-positioned to capitalize on continued digital transformation trends in the manufacturing sector. The company expects to maintain strong double-digit growth rates, targeting revenue in the range of $6.8-$7.2 million, representing 29-37% year-over-year growth. Management anticipates maintaining operating margins in the 12-14% range while continuing strategic investments in product development and market expansion. Key growth drivers include expanding the company's footprint in mid-market manufacturing segments, enhancing AI and machine learning capabilities across all product lines, and pursuing strategic partnerships to accelerate market penetration. The company's strong balance sheet and cash position provide flexibility to execute on these growth initiatives while maintaining financial discipline.
